faults.title: Turbocharger trouble on 1.4 petrol
faults.description: Turbocharger faults have been reported on the 1.4-litre petrol Mk1 A1. Smoke from the exhaust is a reason to stop and have the engine and turbo inspected before further use.

faults.title: Sticking electric windows
faults.description: Some first-generation A1 electric windows can stick. Operate every window during a viewing and have persistent binding or failed movement diagnosed before replacing parts.
